# `^B9` – UPC-E Bar Code

[Overview](../README.md) · [Libraries](../libraries/README.md) · [Commands](README.md) · [Features](../features/README.md) · [Evidence legend](../METHODOLOGY.md) · [Compare images](../../benchmarks/accuracy/comparisons/README.md)


Print a UPC-E barcode, a zero-suppressed variation of UPC-A.

Reference parameters: **o, h, f, g, e**. These describe the reference grammar, not a promise that any library honors every parameter. [Zebra guide, page 85](../../zpl-zbi2-pg-en.pdf).
